h1: Pipeline stages that match your sales cycle
overview: Many pipelines have too many stages or names nobody agrees on. We map how a deal really moves in your business, from first enquiry to won or lost, then build those stages in your CRM. Each stage gets a plain definition, an entry rule and a next step for the owner. Lost deals get a reason list, so you can see why you lose work. You also get a one page guide your team can pin up.

faq: How do you decide the stages?

We ask how a typical deal goes, who is involved and what proof shows it moved forward. Stages describe what the customer did, not what your team hopes. We share a draft first and adjust before we build.
Will my current deals be lost?
No. Open deals stay where they are and we map each old stage to a new one. On Standard and Premium we move them for you and send a before and after list so you can check.
Can the pipeline differ by product?
Yes. If you sell a service and a product with different cycles, we can build separate pipelines. Basic has one pipeline, Standard has two and Premium covers up to four.
Stage design focuses on the structure and the rules. Moving tasks and reminders that run on their own belong to Sales Automations, which you can order separately once the stages are agreed.
